# Audio test fixtures — the four-rung ladder + the scene pack

Three synthesized (2026-07-12, no human recordings) plus one REAL recording
(2026-08-18, the owner and his son). The synthesized three: one scripted
two-person argument (calm open → escalation → shouted spike → cold contempt
→ sad → scared → repair → calm close), three ways. Regenerate with
scripts/make_test_recording*.py. A second table below covers the
2026-08-24 multi-speaker **scene pack** (Foundation D) — three acted scenes
with a fixed "self" voice and an expected-nudge timeline.

| File | Engine | Deepgram diarization | diarize_local (ECAPA, measured 2026-08-17/18) | Use for |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| test_recording.wav | Deepgram Aura-2 + mathematical gain/tempo modulation | **1 speaker (WRONG — merges everyone)**: robotic sameness + resample pitch-shift breaks voice identity (nova-3, measured 2026-07-12) | 2 speakers, agreement 0.7-1.0 ceiling (`test_diarize_local_live.py`) | Prosody-METER ground truth only (meta carries expected energy/rate labels; the modulated turns are physically known) |
| test_recording_openai.wav | OpenAI gpt-4o-mini-tts-2025-12-15, acted via instructions | **2 speakers, clean** (nova-3, measured 2026-07-12) | **2 speakers, 10/10 = 100% exact per-turn accuracy** | The clean end-to-end pipeline case |
| test_recording_gptaudio.wav | OpenAI gpt-audio-1.5 (voice-actor prompt) | 2 speakers + 2 turns misattributed to a phantom Speaker C (nova-3, measured 2026-07-12) | **2 speakers, 10/10 = 100% exact per-turn accuracy** — the old phantom-C regression is gone | Realism STRESS test — extreme acted shifts fool clustering the way real fights do. Owner-rated the most human-sounding of the three. |
| test_recording_family_real.wav | REAL recording — owner + son, ~30s, alternating strict 5s turns | **1 speaker (WRONG — merges an adult and a child)** (nova-2, measured live 2026-08-18) | **2 speakers, 8/8 = 100% exact per-turn accuracy** | The project's first REAL (non-synthetic) calibration case, and proof the ECAPA cross-check earns its keep on real audio, not just acted TTS — see `test_recording_family_real_meta.json`'s `_note` for the full story. |

## Scene pack (Foundation D, 2026-08-24) — `test_recording_scene_*.wav`

Generated by `scripts/make_test_recording_scenes.py` (OpenAI
gpt-4o-mini-tts-2025-12-15, acted via `instructions`, REUSING the
make_test_recording_openai.py helpers). Written at **16 kHz mono** (not the
engine's native 24 kHz — the ECAPA contract rate, and ~2 MB/min), with each
turn's TTS edge-silence trimmed so `silence_gap_sec` is the only silence
between turns. **`Speaker A` is "self" in every scene and is always the
`onyx` voice**, so a voiceprint enrolled from one scene matches self — and
only self — in the other two (measured: self 0.89-0.94 cosine, every
non-self 0.09-0.28; `test_diarize_scenes.py::test_self_voiceprint_transfers_across_scenes`).
Pinned regression tests: `server/tests/test_diarize_scenes.py`.

| File | Voices (self first) | Length / turns | diarize_local (ECAPA, measured 2026-08-24) | Use for |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| test_recording_scene_couple_escalation.wav | onyx + coral | 69.6 s, 13 turns, 0.4 s gaps | **2 speakers, 13/13 = 100%** (k=2 pooled cosine 0.251) | The canonical self-escalation arc: calm → tense → self `tense_rising` → `shout_angry` → `cold_contempt` → partner hurt → self repairs → warm close. 3 expected nudges (mild, strong, strong). |
| test_recording_scene_family3.wav | onyx + ballad + nova | 67.1 s, 15 turns, **0.25 s gaps** | **3 speakers, 15/15 = 100%** (k=3 marginal 0.237, anchor 0.065) | Rapid 3-way turn-taking; a NON-self shout (teen, turn 7) that must NOT nudge, one brief self flare (`defensive_rising`, turn 9) → exactly one mild nudge. The clean 3-speaker reference. |
| test_recording_scene_meeting4.wav | onyx + marin + ballad + nova | 82.9 s, 17 turns, 0.4 s gaps | **2 speakers, 11/17 = 64.7% — SELF isolated on all 6 of its turns, the three colleagues merged** (k=3 rejected: marginal 0.339 vs the 0.32 bar; k=4 nowhere near) | Speaker-count discovery at 4 + a late self escalation (`tense_rising` turn 11 → mild, `shout_angry` turn 13 → strong) after ~45 s of neutral meeting talk (false-nudge trap). **Documents a real ceiling** — see below. |

**The 4-voice ceiling is measured, not assumed.** Voice sets were chosen from
a scratch ECAPA probe of all 13 OpenAI TTS voices (one neutral + one shouted
line each; `onyx` was the best hub voice, hence self). Four different
4-voice sets were generated and run through `diarize_local` before
accepting the meeting4 numbers: alloy/ballad/sage → k=3 (ballad+sage merged
at 0.378), echo/ballad/nova → k=2 (echo pulled self in), cedar/ballad/nova
→ k=3 (cedar merged with SELF at 0.389), marin/ballad/nova → k=2 with self
isolated (shipped). No set cleared `STRONG_SEPARATION_COSINE` (0.32) at
k=4: real pooled centroids run 0.03-0.09 above the probe's single-utterance
estimate, and OpenAI's female voices sit 0.45-0.74 from each other. The
shipped set is the one whose failure is least harmful to the pack's purpose
(self attribution stays perfect, so the nudge timeline is still testable).
If `test_scene_meeting4_pinned` ever fails UPWARD (3 or 4 speakers), the
pipeline improved — re-measure and raise the pin. Do NOT tune the
diarizer's thresholds to this fixture: they were calibrated on real voices
(family_real, poker6).

### Scene meta schema (`*_scene_*_meta.json`)

Same `turns[]` shape as the OpenAI metas (`speaker`, `text`,
`scripted_emotion`, `instruction`, `duration_sec`) so
`test_diarize_regression_ladder.py::_build_turns` works unchanged, plus:

- `speakers` — label → `{voice, is_self, role}`; `self_speaker`
  (`"Speaker A"`); `num_speakers_true`.
- `emotion_coarse` per turn — `scripted_emotion` collapsed to
  `neutral | angry | sad | happy` by the fixed `EMOTION_COARSE` table in the
  generator, so a tone-scoring test never re-derives the mapping.
  `tense_rising`/`defensive_rising`/`shout_angry`/`cold_contempt` → angry;
  `hurt_sad`/`sullen_sad`/`scared_shaky` → sad (fear collapses to sad — the
  listener probe below shows even gpt-audio can't tell them apart);
  `warm_happy` → happy; every `calm_*`/`repair_*` → neutral.
- `expected_nudges[]` — `{after_turn_index, level: "mild"|"strong", reason}`.
  **Hand-authored from the script, NOT measured** (each meta's `_note` says
  so): `after_turn_index` is 0-based into `turns` and always names a SELF
  turn; mild = self `tense_rising`/`defensive_rising`, strong = self
  `shout_angry`/`cold_contempt`. Non-self escalations deliberately have no
  entry — a nudge there is a false positive. The pure schema test enforces
  "every angry self turn has exactly one nudge and nothing else does", so
  the timeline can't drift from the script.
- Every scene meta is also diffed field-by-field against the generator's
  `SCENES` table (`test_scene_metas_match_generator_script`), and
  `sum(duration_sec) + gap*(n-1)` must equal the WAV length within 0.01 s
  for every concatenated-TTS fixture in this directory.

The nova-3 column is the VENDOR diarizer (Deepgram) and was not re-measured
here — it is a different system from `diarize_local`, the local ECAPA
fallback that exists BECAUSE nova-3 regressed (see `diarize_local.py`'s
module docstring). The `diarize_local` column is fresh as of 2026-08-17
(`server/tests/test_diarize_regression_ladder.py`, added that day): the
gptaudio fixture's 2026-07-12 "phantom Speaker C" claim predates
2026-08-14/15's N-way k-detection, anchor recalibration (0.15→0.20) and
word-level rapid-exchange splitting, and does not reproduce on the current
pipeline — ground-truth-verified first (script/meta diff + independent local
Whisper transcription + duration check, see
`.superpowers/sdd/2026-08-17-diarization-regression/report.md`), not assumed.

Lessons encoded here:
- Physics modulation validates the measurement layer; acted speech validates
  listeners/diarizers. Naive tempo resampling shifts pitch and destroys voice
  identity — never use the physics fixture to test diarization.
- gpt-audio-1.5 as a LISTENER (scripts/audio_tone_probe.py): correctly hears
  anger/sadness/calm arcs (shout = arousal peak) but confuses fear with
  sadness and returned unparseable JSON ~30% of the time (probe records those
  as honest errors).
- `diarize_local` requires 16 kHz input (`speaker_id.TARGET_SR`); the OpenAI
  TTS fixtures are natively 24 kHz, so a caller must resample first (the
  regression tests use `audio_ingest.decode_to_pcm_16k`, the same path
  `routers/voice.py` uses for voice enrollment). This surfaced that
  `main.py`'s `/analyze/upload` cross-check was instead calling plain
  `decode_to_pcm` (native rate preserved) before invoking `diarize_local`,
  so on a real upload whose native WAV rate isn't already 16 kHz the ECAPA
  cross-check silently no-opped (caught by the broad `except Exception` a few
  lines later) — **fixed 2026-08-18** (`main.py` now decodes separately at
  16 kHz for the cross-check call). `test_recording_family_real.wav` is the
  real-world proof this fix matters: its native rate isn't 16 kHz, Deepgram
  mis-heard it as one speaker, and the (now-fixed) cross-check correctly
  split it into two.
